entities.summary: Luisa Estela Fuentes Quijandría, more commonly known as Lucha Fuentes, was a Peruvian volleyball player who played with the national team in the 1968 and 1976 Summer Olympics. As the captain of the Peruvian team, she was nicknamed "La Gran Capitana".
